name: P0
desc: port 0 (QFP pins 3-10): head strobe lines for band rows 0-7 (bit n = row n); wired to the transistor arrays IC5/IC6 (board)

name: P1
desc: port 1 (QFP pins 11-18): head strobe lines for band rows 8-15; wired to IC5/IC6 (board)

name: P2
desc: port 2: bit0 front button (P20 = INT5/STOP pin 19; 0 = pressed); bit1 SRAM /WE (P21/XTIN pin 21); bit2 SRAM /CE (P22/XTOUT pin 22)

name: P4
desc: port 4: bits 0-4 SRAM address high (written OR 0xE0); bits 5-7 SIO2

name: P5
desc: port 5: bit0 encoder (P50 = INT3/TC3 pin 44); bit1 cam sensor (P51 = INT4/TC4 pin 45); bit2 motor (0 = run); bit3 ?; bit4 SRAM /OE

name: P7CR
desc: port 7 direction (0xFF = output for SRAM writes)

name: ADCCR
desc: A/D control: low bits channel (0 = AIN0/P60 pin 50 temperature: other error 0x40 outside 0x35-0xD7 and strobe base time; 1 = AIN1/P61 pin 51 battery: low battery 0x80 at 0x7E or below); bit6 start; bit7 end of conversion

name: TREG1A
desc: timer 1 register A (16-bit): strobe tick length in us

name: TREG2
desc: timer 2 register (16-bit): 0x000A = 10.24 ms tick; 0x03D5 = 1.0 s in idle

name: TC4CR
desc: timer 4 control: 0xD0 = start fc/2^11 (inter-byte timeout 5.12 ms); 0xC0 = stop and clear

name: SIO2CR1
desc: serial 2 control 1: 0x67 = stop / 8-bit transmit-receive external clock; 0xA7 = start
